build.run: npm run build && node scripts/verify-package.mjs && node scripts/check-tree-shaking.mjs

quirks: devcontainer.json sets no workspaceFolder, so the container path defaults to /workspaces/<checkout folder name>, which differs per worktree; declaring it in devcontainer.json makes /workspaces/ui hold everywhere.
The devcontainer's postCreateCommand already runs npm ci and installs Playwright's Chromium, which the browser gate needs.
There is no format or separate typecheck script: tsc -b runs inside npm run build, and npm run types:css must run after a CSS Module class is added or removed.
The required check 'quality / Lint, test and build' also runs npm run audit (audit-ci with audit-ci.jsonc's allowlist) and npm run test:coverage; CI never runs npm run test:storybook.
main only accepts squash merges with linear history, resolved review threads and a code owner's approval (.github/CODEOWNERS).
semantic-release publishes to npm on every push to main and commits 'chore: release <version> [skip ci]' there; fix and perf commits scoped deps or deps-dev don't release.
Never bump the version in package.json in a pull request (CONTRIBUTING.md#versioning).

stack.basis: Estimate: a single typescript-node:22 devcontainer with no services; the peak is the Storybook browser suite running headless Chromium beside Vitest workers, plus about 1 GiB of node_modules and the Chromium download per worktree.
